title: RF32CG button UI — Test Mode entry
description: Fridge + Dot Line or AutoFill 6 s → enter Test Mode.

steps.title: Enter Test Mode
steps.body: RF31/26CG: Fridge + dot line 6 s → dot line. RF32CG5300: Fridge + AutoFill 6 s → AutoFill. Cycle FF → FF F2 → FF F1 → FF A → Fd.
